events.verdict: McCollum (NOP) has a resting forearm on George's (UTA) body, which he removes as George starts his upward shooting motion as the contact that occurs during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Green (NOP) briefly grasps Kessler's (UTA) arm and releases as both players pursue the rebound, which is marginal.
Murray (NOP) swipes down and initiates contact with Collier's (UTA) lower body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Murphy III (NOP) makes clean contact the ball after Kessler (UTA) establishes control of the rebound.
Utah (UTA) does not release the shot attempt prior to the expiration of the shot clock. A shot clock violation is correctly whistled.
McCollum (NOP) brings two hands to Collier's (UTA) body and slightly extends his arms as he releases away from Collier as the screen is set by Theis (NOP).
Kessler (UTA) gets drawn in the air and away from Murray (NOP) when he lowers his arm and makes contact to Murray's wrist as the contact that occurs is marginal.
Sensabaugh (UTA) and Theis (NOP) mutually engage and disengage during the rebound.
Theis (NOP) moves alongside George's (UTA) path at the start of the drive as both players come together, which is marginal as George is able to move through the contact.
Theis (NOP) keeps both his arms and his body vertical as he legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot attempt

Murray (NOP) brings his hands to Kessler's (UTA) body and slightly extends his arms as Kessler's momentum drifts to the right while he attempts the shot near the basket as the contact that occurs from Murray is marginal.
Murray (NOP) releases the inbounds pass within five seconds.
McCollum (NOP) briefly engages with Collier (UTA) off-ball before slightly extending his arms and releasing from Collier as the contact that occurs is marginal.
Collier (UTA) reaches around McCollum (NOP) and makes contact to his lower body after the gather, which is marginal as McCollum is able to move through the contact during the driving shot attempt.
Filipowski (UTA) clamps and holds Theis's (NOP) arm, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Theis (NOP) establishes a screening position in George's (UTA) path and absorbs the incoming contact as he is firming up when the screen is set.
Kessler (UTA) is in a legal guarding position moving alongside of Murray's (NOP) path and Murray creates the contact during his driving shot attempt.
Green (NOP) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Collier (UTA) after receiving the inbounds pass.
Collier (UTA) controls the loose ball, gathers on his right foot, and establishes his left foot as his pivot, which he maintains.
Green (NOP) brings his arm toward Collier's (UTA) path and marginal contact occurs at the start of Collier's drive as Collier is able to move through the contact.
Green (NOP) contests Collier's (UTA) shot attempt and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Robinson-Earl (NOP) contests Filipowski's (UTA) shot attempt and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
McCollum (NOP) brings his hand to Collier's (UTA) body and slightly extends his arm as he releases while the screen is set, which is marginal.
Collier (UTA) moves laterally into McCollum's (NOP) path and initiates contact to his body, which affects McCollum's driving shot attempt.
Green (NOP) makes clean contact to the ball during George's (UTA) upward shooting motion on the driving shot attempt.
George (UTA) slightly extends his lower body into Murray's (NOP) space as he makes contact with Murray in the backcourt, which is marginal as Murray is able to move through the contact.
Collier (UTA) has his arm extended in McCollum's (NOP) path, which he then absorbs as McCollum is able to move through it as the screen is set by Theis (NOP).

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Green (NOP) is last to make contact with the ball prior to it going out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to UTA.
Green (NOP) extends his leg in George's (UTA) path and initiates contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Collier (UTA) and McCollum (NOP) mutually engage and disengage as the screen is set by Theis (NOP).
McCollum (NOP) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes one step before releasing the pass at the end of the drive.
Filipowski (UTA) releases the inbounds pass within five seconds.
Robinson-Earl (NOP) slightly extends his forearm into Kessler's (UTA) body as he is in his shooting motion near the basket, which is marginal.
Mykhailiuk (UTA) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
McCollum (NOP) releases from Kessler (UTA) as the contact that occurs at the end of the drive is marginal.
Theis (NOP) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes two steps prior to releasing the pass.
Mykhailiuk (UTA) commits a take foul on Murphy III (NOP).
George (UTA) gathers the ball while airborne, takes one step, and comes to a legal jump stop prior to releasing the jump shot attempt.
